opened_data.purpose: Estimate whether an anchor-time brake or recovery action changes endpoint semantic quality, and whether pre-action cheap signals rank that treatment gain.

candidate.reason: This opened development candidate supplies two reproduced VQAScore failures. Results cannot directly qualify the conservative brake-only serving candidate.

quality_contract.failure_rule: fail when baseline-minus-candidate harm is strictly greater than either frozen metric margin

target_selection: For each requested phase, select the nearest naturally computed anchor whose pre-measurement policy state is ACTIVE, whose estimate error is valid, whose pre-anchor interval is above the candidate minimum, and which leaves at least minimum_remaining_steps. Ties choose the earlier anchor. Selection uses no endpoint score.

action_semantics.continue: Ignore the target measurement once, preserve the pre-anchor interval, and resume ordinary adaptive control at later anchors.
action_semantics.brake: At the target anchor force the candidate minimum interval, then resume ordinary adaptive control at later anchors.
action_semantics.recovery: At the target anchor force the candidate recovery_steps consecutive real steps and minimum interval, then resume ordinary adaptive control.

paired_identity_gate: Every action arm must match exact hashes of the pre-step latent and real Transformer output at the selected target anchor, and must reproduce the same target anchor error and pre-anchor interval.
action_order: Within each sample and phase, order continue/brake/recovery by SHA-256(protocol content hash, sample_id, phase, action) to distribute hardware-order effects deterministically.
primary_action_cost: extra full Transformer steps relative to continue

decision_rule.positive_pilot: At least one known failure is rescued by brake or recovery, without an introduced contract failure in a pass control, and at least one pre-action signal has directionally positive rank association with the corresponding metric treatment gain.
decision_rule.negative_pilot: No known failure is rescued, or both actions are consistently too late at all three phases.
decision_rule.next_if_positive: Freeze a smaller signal/action hypothesis and test it on a newly registered paired-intervention holdout before changing any serving controller.
decision_rule.next_if_negative: Change the predictor or cache granularity; do not retune the current scalar anchor-error thresholds on these opened requests.
